description:
Create an API key for an organization.
The response contains the new key's value in token.
It is a live credential, so give it to the user to store in a secret manager, and do not repeat it, log it, or pass it to another tool.
Which key types you can create depends on how you authenticate.
With the GraphOS sign-in (OAuth), you can create OPERATOR, SCIM, and GATEWAY keys.
SUBGRAPH and VARIANT keys need a personal API key in the x-api-key header.
With an operator key in x-api-key, you can create only GATEWAY keys, and a graph key can create none.
No credential can create ROUTER keys.
OPERATOR, SCIM, and GATEWAY keys also require the Org Admin role.
GATEWAY keys are used by Apollo Gateway instances.
Choose the narrowest type that does the job, and confirm the type and its resources with the user before you call this tool.
Provide the organization ID, the key name, and the type.
For a SUBGRAPH key, list each graphId, variantName, and subgraphName in resources.subgraphs.
For a VARIANT key, list each graphId and variantName in resources.variants.

ApiKeyResourceInput.description: The target resource(s) that a key has access to

gateways.description: One or more gateways that a key has access to

subgraphs.description: One or more subgraphs that a key has access to

variants.description: One or more variants that a key has access to

graphId.description: Optional graph id associated with this gateway key. When omitted, gatewayId is used.

Values:
